name: v0.43.2
body:
This is a bugfix release.

### 🚒 Nodes no longer stop accepting inbound connections

**Problem:** A node that accepts inbound connections could stop taking new peers after it had run for a while.

**Reason:** If an inbound connection closed after its security handshake but before libp2p passed it to the node, the [resource manager](https://github.com/ipfs/kubo/blob/master/docs/libp2p-resource-management.md) kept the connection and file descriptor reservations for it. No socket stayed open, but these reservations added up until they filled `System.ConnsInbound`. From then on the node refused every new inbound connection, even when only a few connections were live. AutoNAT also started to report the node's addresses as unreachable, because the dial-backs were refused too. On busy public nodes this leaked thousands of reservations per day, and the default limit filled within hours to days. A restart cleared the reservations, but they built up again.

**Fix:** [go-libp2p v0.52.0](https://github.com/libp2p/go-libp2p/releases/tag/v0.52.0) fixes the leak ([libp2p/go-libp2p#3564](https://github.com/libp2p/go-libp2p/issues/3564)).

If you raised `System.ConnsInbound` in `libp2p-resource-limit-overrides.json` or scheduled restarts to work around this, you can remove those changes after you upgrade.

#### 📦️ Dependency updates

- update `go-libp2p` to [0.52.0](https://github.com/libp2p/go-libp2p/releases/tag/0.52.0)
